selection: Positive at 5% and 10% costs with the named sample and drawdown limits; maximize training return at 10% cost. Ties retain catalog order. The robust selector must remain positive after removing its two best 10%-cost training tokens.
scope: Retrospective daily refits on examined dates. Earlier saved entry/cohort gates and daily full-loss budgets remain fixed; activity multipliers, allocation scale and exit are selected on earlier completed outcomes.
missingActivity: A missing field fails its condition; the configured rejection or size reduction applies.
economicShareMeaning: Net within-transaction token flow divided by gross flow; this is a route/churn proxy, not evidence of wash trading.
